title: AI for Games in the Foundation Model Era
abstract: arXiv:2609.16679v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models, alongside advances in learned game-world models, are reshaping AI across the game lifecycle. Beyond playing games, recent systems model players and game dynamics, support design and development, adapt player-facing experiences at runtime, and evaluate resulting artifacts. Yet these directions have evolved largely separately, obscuring which capabilities transfer across settings and which remain tied to particular games, engines, interfaces, or player populations. We organize the literature into six roles according to the immediate use of AI output: playing and acting; modeling players and games; designing games; building and maintaining games; generating and adapting at runtime; and testing and evaluating games. translated_abstract: 基础模型以及学习型游戏世界模型的进展，正在重塑贯穿游戏整个生命周期的AI技术。除了玩游戏之外，近期的系统还能够对玩家和游戏动态进行建模，支持设计与开发，在运行时适配面向玩家的体验，并评估所产生的成果。然而，这些研究方向在很大程度上是彼此独立发展的，这使得哪些能力能够在不同场景间迁移、哪些仍与特定游戏、引擎、接口或玩家群体绑定变得模糊不清。我们根据AI输出的直接用途将相关文献组织为六种角色：玩游戏与执行动作；对玩家和游戏进行建模；设计游戏；构建和维护游戏；在运行时生成与适配；以及测试和评估游戏。针对每种角色，我们考察了游戏或工作流提供了何种结构、AI学习或生成什么、哪些能力和成果可以在不同场景与角色之间迁移，以及有哪些证据支持这些主张。
tldr: 本文系统梳理了基础模型时代游戏AI的文献，按AI输出的直接用途将其划分为六种角色（玩游戏与行动、建模玩家与游戏、设计游戏、构建与维护游戏、运行时生成与适配、测试与评估游戏），并分析了哪些能力和成果能够在不同场景与角色之间迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically surveys AI for games in the foundation model era by organizing the literature into six roles according to the immediate use of AI output, and examines which capabilities and artifacts transfer across settings and roles.
